links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient education responses against sixth-grade benchmark
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade readability target; best Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level was 9.95 (DeepSeek-v3.2, SD 1.87) and best Flesch Reading Ease 48.23.
links.quote: No model met the recommended sixth-grade readability target.

links.outcome: Plain-language readability of LLM-generated patient education responses
links.effect: No model met the sixth-grade benchmark; DeepSeek-v3.2 most readable with FRE 48.23 and FKGL 9.95; significant between-model differences (all P<.001).
links.quote: No model met the sixth-grade readability benchmark, including those with comparatively stronger reliability performance.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 6 LLMs generating patient-facing educational materials for age-related macular degeneration scored by expert ophthalmologists and readability formulas; compares models but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
